settings.default: Pre-orders reserve a unit from our allocation. You're charged when you order (or the deposit shown, where offered). Pre-order items ship as soon as they land in NZ, separately from in-stock items. Dates may change — if your model is delayed or cancelled by the manufacturer you can request a full refund.
